commands: '=== is the IP Restrictions module/feature installed? ==='

try { $c = Get-WebConfiguration -Filter $f -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST'; "denyByConcurrentRequests.enabled=$($c.denyByConcurrentRequests.enabled) max=$($c.denyByConcurrentRequests.maxConcurrentRequests)"; "denyByRequestRate.enabled=$($c.denyByRequestRate.enabled) max=$($c.denyByRequestRate.maxRequests) intervalMs=$($c.denyByRequestRate.requestIntervalInMilliseconds)"; "denyAction=$($c.denyAction)" } catch { "no dynamicIpSecurity at apphost: $($_.Exception.Message.Split([Environment]::NewLine)[0])" }
